{{Top|leg}}
The '''Long Range Scout package''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] electronics package under development at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Galactic War]]. One revision of the package generated a dangerous interference pattern in [[Starship/Legends|starships]]' secondary weapons systems, causing erratic missile behavior and some warheads to arm themselves while still in the launcher.
